preamble: Caravan Crossing (Basic): Five caravans travel across the Sahara. Communication between groups is carried out by trained human runners—lean, heat-hardened couriers who carry parchment slips between caravans whenever decisions must be coordinated. In this scenario, the lead caravan dispatches runners carrying a proposal for where to make camp. The nearby caravans acknowledge the message and their own runners depart in return. With everyone reachable and no sandstorms blocking the paths, a majority is quickly achieved. Consensus is reached on the campsite and all caravans record the decision in their travel-ledgers.

events.data: Proposal delivered by runner: Make camp at Oasis Z
Follow-up dispatch: Confirm water stores and route markings
